scope: Charging only; retain Linux 7.3, current nixpkgs toolchain, XN242 VDDIO and unrelated devices. No reference repository is a build/runtime dependency.
adaptations: Use devm_kzalloc on 7.3 instead of the 7.4 devm_kzalloc_obj macro.
Use the existing pmk8550_adc node for SID 7 connector NTC channels.
Carry only Erhai charging additions to Kconfig/Makefile and the hardware fragment.
Import the Gen4 ADC and PMIC GLINK sleep/wakeup prerequisite patches with their original authors and trailers; adapt context around the existing client-neuter API.
Do not import Xiaomi MCA or unrelated board changes.
UFCS auth firmware is optional; an absent key keeps the reference unverified 4 A ceiling without copying device identity.
